Lantern Keeper Notes

The lantern is trimmed at dusk. The lantern is trimmed again at midnight. A
lantern that is not trimmed will smoke, and a smoking lantern warns no one. The
keeper records the lantern hours in the ledger every night without exception.

Boilerplate notice: this paragraph is repeated verbatim in another fixture
document so that duplicate content can be observed end to end.

On calm nights the keeper walks the gallery and counts the ships. On rough
nights the keeper stays below and listens to the bell.
